infoLinks.urlText: L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weeknight closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford lines
  • L2 and L3 services will not run on Monday 22 to Thursday 25 June, nightly from 8pm to 1am.
  • Use alternative transport including trains, metro, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Circular Quay and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford.
  • The L1 weeknight closure from Monday 22 to Wednesday 24 June may also impact your journey.
L2 and L3 Replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services between Central Chalmers Street and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford will run every 10-15 minutes from 8pm to 1am nightly. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Surry Hills (towards Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford) - Please use the alternative stop at Central Chalmers Street (approx. 8 minute walk),\Wansey Road (towards Central) - Please use the alternative stop at Royal Randwick (approx. 12 minute walk),
    • UNSW High Street (towards Central and Randwick) - Please use the alternative stop at Randwick (approx. 10 minute walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
  • Where the replacement bus has an opal reader onboard, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
L2 and L3 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Friday 26 June.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 partial line closure for Parramatta Half Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 21 June, from 5am to 12 midday, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta Square due to road closures for the Parramatta Half Marathon.  
  • Light rail services will continue to run between Parramatta Square and Carlingford.  
  • During this time, use alternative transport including trains, L4 replacement bus services, regular bus services, or walking if able to, between Westmead and Parramatta Square.  
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5am to 12 midday on Sunday 21 June. These frequencies may vary subject to traffic conditions.  
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:  
    • Westmead Hospital - Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)  
    • Ngara - Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk)  
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.  
  • Where the replacement bus has an opal reader on board, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.  
  • Visit the Parramatta Half Marathon event page for more details on the event.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta CBD diversions due to Parramatta Half Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 21 June, from 3am to 11am, route 545 buses will be diverting and using different stops while roads are closed for the Parramatta Half Marathon. 
  • Buses will divert around George St and Macarthur St via Wilde Ave, Smith St and Station St East in both directions to access Parramatta Bus Interchange, making stops along the detoured route. 
  • Stops on George St and Macarthur St will be missed in both directions. 
  • Visit the Parramatta Half Marathon event page for more details. 
Missed stops:
  • Macarthur St before Thomas St (215044) 
  • Macarthur St opp Macarthur Girls High School (2150117) 
  • Macarthur Girls High School, Macarthur St (2150116) 
  • Macarthur St after Thomas St (215043)
  • George St after Smith St (215069) 
  • George St before MacArthur St (215070)

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125

Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
 
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
 
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
 
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
 
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield
infoLinks.content:
Monday 30 and Tuesday 31 March
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Leppington and Glenfield.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Macarthur, Glenfield and the City via Granville.
  • Buses also replace T8 Airport & South Line trains between Glenfield, Sydenham and Central via the Airport.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
9T2 Leppington, Edmondson Park, Glenfield and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services in Lithgow
infoLinks.content:
There are timetable changes to school transport services impacted by the closure of the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass. Changes should reduce travel time for the majority of students.  
  • Some students may have different times for their bus service or a slightly longer walk to their bus stop. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by bus from Hartley Vale to Lithgow train station and transfer to a train to Wentworth Falls. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by train from Blackheath station to Wentworth Falls station.  
  • Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
  • Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Epping or Chatswood and the City
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 27 and Sunday 28 June
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • Use trains between Epping or Chatswood and the City.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Buses also replace T4 Illawarra and T8 Airport & South Line trains between Central and Sydenham.
  • Southwest Link buses do not run between Bankstown and Sydenham. Alternative bus routes run between Bankstown and Central.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
10M Epping, all stations to Chatswood and return
11M Tallawong, all stations to Chatswood and return
12M Tallawong, all stations to Epping, then North Ryde, Chatswood and return
24T3 Bankstown, all stations to Belmore, Lewisham, Central and return
35T3 Bankstown, all stations to Sydenham, St Peters, Erskineville, Redfern, Central and return
78T3 Campsie, Canterbury, Lewisham, Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: At Hawkesbury River and Cowan, trains may leave from different platforms.  If travelling to Cowan you may need to change at Hawkesbury River for a bus
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 27 June   
  • From 5.30am to 10.30am, at Hawkesbury River and Cowan, all trains leave from platform 2.

  • From 7am to 10.30am, trains towards Hornsby do not stop at Cowan.
  • Buses run from Hawkesbury River to Cowan, and from Cowan to Berowra, in that direction only.
  • If travelling to Cowan, change at Hawkesbury River for a bus.
  • At Cowan, catch a bus to Berowra then change for a train to continue your journey.
  • Trains towards Gosford continue to stop at Cowan.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
50CN Hawkesbury River, Cowan, Berowra (in that direction only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill weeknight closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
Nightly from 8pm to 1am: L1 Dulwich Hill from Monday 22 to Wednesday 24 June, and L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines, from Monday 22 to Thursday 25 June light rail will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
 
L1 Dulwich Hill line
  • L1 services will not run between Central Grand Concourse and Convention on Monday 22 to Wednesday 24 June, nightly from 8pm to 1am.
  • Use alternative transport including L1 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able to.
  • L1 light rail services will continue running between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • L2 and L3 weeknight closures from Monday 22 to Thursday 25 June may also impact your journey.
L1 replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services between Central Grand Concourse and The Star will run every 10-15 minutes from 8pm to 1am nightly.
  • These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Capitol Square (in both directions): please use the alternative stop at Paddy’s Market (approx. 5 minute walk) for buses towards Dulwich Hill/The Star, or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk),
    • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill/The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk).
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service. 
  • Where the replacement bus has an opal reader onboard, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
L1 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Thursday 25 June.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Sydenham, Central and Bondi Junction
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 4 and Sunday 5 July   
  • Buses replace trains between Sydenham, Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trains run between Waterfall or Cronulla and Sydenham only.
  • Change at:
    - Wolli Creek for trains to the City Circle via the Airport
    - Sydenham for metro services to Central, Martin Place or Gadigal (Town Hall), or buses to St Peters, Erskineville or Redfern
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff, or metro services to Martin Place
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction

  • Replacement buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
1T3  Sydenham, all stations to Central and return
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
